estate_access.blocking_finding: mvmhyperv01.ad.hraedon.com (DNS A 192.168.1.207 + AAAA fd21:16a3:6695:428e:a20e:31b0:bed7:3e1e) unreachable from the WCD workstation (SHODAN 192.168.1.220, same /24, direct ARP): ARP never resolves, ICMP/TCP dead. Reachable from mvmcc02 (192.168.1.30, neighbor MAC f8:f2:1e:0d:c0:58, ping 0.3ms) and from mvmhyperv02. Worked from the workstation during window 10 itself, so this is a regression introduced after 2026-09-19 ~06:00Z, switch-side (no host change: VMs never moved, node Up in cluster mvmhyperv, mgmt IP unchanged on Mgmt-10G via DHCP).
estate_access.workaround_used: operator scripts only, via the double-hop workstation -> mvmhyperv02 (WinRM, svc_claude) -> mvmhyperv01 (WinRM) -> LabMS01 (PSDirect) / VM-bus CIM. The ENGINE cannot run transactions over this path (SessionTransport connects to estate.host directly); exec-transaction re-runs wait on a network repair or an owner decision.
estate_access.operator_trap: in a double-hop script every guest/host operation must be wrapped in Invoke-Command -Session of the machine that owns the cmdlet; a bare Get-VM/PSDirect line in the outer scriptblock silently executes on mvmhyperv02 and reports 'vm not found' intermittently (cost two false alarms before the probe loop proved the path 6/6 stable).

session_repair.observed: the claude console session left by window 10 (logon 05:01) vanished with no session at all by mid-session (quser: 'No User exists'); cause not identified (no matching 4634 captured in the retained window). mmc died with it.
session_repair.keyboard_logon: REJECTED as the re-establishment path: the preselected-tile trap from window 10 still applies, and with the framebuffer frozen (display off) the per-step captures were unreadable -- six identical frames through ESC/DOWN/ENTER/type/submit, no session resulted.
session_repair.autologon_clean_restart: FAILS: Restart-Computer (clean shutdown processing) wipes DefaultUserName/DefaultDomainName from Winlogon before the next boot; winlogon then attempts AutoAdminLogon with a BLANK user (SEC 4625 TargetUserName empty, SubStatus 0xc0000064, winlogon op event 'Authentication stopped. Result 1326'), consumes AutoLogonCount and clears DefaultPassword itself. Registry after: user=[], dom=[], pw absent.
session_repair.autologon_hard_cycle: WORKS: arm AutoAdminLogon=1/AutoLogonCount=1/DefaultUserName/DefaultDomainName/DefaultPassword, then Stop-VM -TurnOff + Start-VM (hard off skips shutdown processing, values survive) -> cold boot processes the logon -> claude console session Active (measured once, 11:52 logon). Clear all five values immediately after. Msvm_Keyboard.SendSAS does not exist on this stack (method not found); killing LogonUI does NOT re-trigger autologon evaluation.
session_repair.display_power: display-off freezes the framebuffer: GetVirtualSystemThumbnailImage returns stale/black frames while input still lands. Fix per boot: powercfg VIDEOIDLE/VIDEOCONLOCK 0 + monitor/standby timeouts 0 (revert on reboot -- re-apply after every cycle); any keypress wakes the display (~2s to first live frame).

synthetic_mouse.SetAbsolutePosition: RAW PIXELS. The documented 0..32767 grid values are clamped to the screen edge (sent 16000,14512 -> guest cursor read back 1023,767). Sent 500,340 -> cursor read back 500,340 exactly.
synthetic_mouse.ClickButton_indices: measured visually: 1 = LEFT (selects the results row under the cursor), 2 = RIGHT (opens the tree context menu at the cursor; ESC closes), 0 = no visible effect (middle).
synthetic_mouse.list_click_position: guest 500,340 (console maximized at 1024x768, results list center) -- the click that puts KEYBOARD focus in the results list.

input_channel_measurements.focus_vs_selection: MMC opens with keyboard focus on the TREE pane. A window-anchored click plus type-ahead moves the row SELECTION but leaves keyboard focus on the tree (measured: TAB TAB changed 3px; typing changed only the status bar; DOWNs walked the tree; Shift+F10 opened nothing). This is the run-33 mechanism: the helper's window-click + type-ahead selected the Copy row, but VM-bus Shift+F10 hit the tree-focused window and no row menu ever opened. Only a real click on a results row puts keyboard focus in the list.
input_channel_measurements.menu_walk_key_loss: with the row context menu OPEN (Shift+F10 after a real list click + type-ahead -- the menu does open, items Open/Duplicate Template/Delete/Rename/Refresh/All Tasks>/-/Export List/-/Properties/-/Help per zoomed captures), VM-bus DOWN moved the highlight for exactly 3 presses (frames differ) then froze (frames 4-8 byte-identical); ESC did not close the menu in the capture window. Same-shape loss as the helper channel (runs 22-30) but at ~3 events instead of ~1: open MMC menus on this build eat synthetic keyboard input. THE MENU WALK IS NOT A VIABLE GESTURE CHANNEL.
input_channel_measurements.helper_console_foreground: a helper-task invocation flashes its own console window to the FOREGROUND (in-session probe measured foreground = 'Administrator: ...powershell.exe' ConsoleWindowClass right after a task run): keyboard injected immediately after ANY helper step can land in that console instead of MMC. Self-anchoring gestures (ESC pair + mouse click) are immune.

alt_enter_opener.gesture: ESC (0.5s settle) -> SetAbsolutePosition(500,340) raw pixels -> ClickButton(1) -> type-ahead row prefix -> ALT+ENTER chord as four consecutive bare [void] CIM key calls
alt_enter_opener.result: opens the selected row's property sheet directly on the General tab, no context menu involved
alt_enter_opener.reproducibility: inline 2/2 + committed script (tools/host_scripts/certtmpl_open_propsheet.ps1, executed via powershell.exe -File on the host exactly like the engine's host-op path) 3/3 including the sheet-close-then-reopen repetition path and the 'copy' row prefix; title read 'Workstation Authentication Properties'; script self-verification (file-hash before/after frames) fired on every failure during bisection and passed on every success
alt_enter_opener.esc_close: a single ESC at ~0.5s settle closed an open sheet reliably in the committed-script repetition runs (earlier 0.9s-settle single-ESC observation did not close it; treat ESC-close as settle-sensitive and verify)
alt_enter_opener.shape_sensitivity: LOAD-BEARING, measured the hard way: a hardened variant of the same script (ReturnValue-checked key wrappers, bitmap-returning capture, 1.2s ESC settle) failed the identical guest state 7/7 with the chord landing as a no-op, while the bare-call form succeeded every time; single-delta bisections (ESC settle, hardcoded prefix, inline chord) each kept the hardened file failing and the bare form passing. The committed script documents this in its header -- any refactor of the input-call shapes needs a live re-verification window.
